editorial.title_zh: 欧盟拟于年底公布废料出口首份准许清单，美欧301争议仍处征求意见阶段
editorial.title_en: EU targets year-end for its first waste export list as proposed US Section 301 duties remain under consultation
editorial.summary_zh: 欧盟《废物运输条例》(EU) 2024/1157第41条第3款原定2026年11月21日前通过首批准许清单，条文列有无人申请或无合格国家的例外。欧委会11月20日说明仍将年底作为公布目标，当前可查为9月18日草案。自2027年5月21日起，欧盟向不适用经合组织决定的国家出口受管非危险废物用于回收，须满足目的地、废物代码及获许可设施等条件。草案中印尼和越南条目未列B1010钢铁废料。11月21日开始适用的禁令涉及塑料废物。报道同时涉及美国11月25日产能过剩301提案，欧盟反对有关过剩产能的认定并要求遵守美欧约定的15%综合税率上限。USTR拟排除已适用232关税的欧盟钢铝制品及有关衍生品，书面意见和听证申请截至2027年1月5日，听证拟于1月25日举行。
editorial.summary_en: Article 41(3) of EU Regulation 2024/1157 specified 21 November 2026 for adopting the first authorised list, subject to stated exceptions. The Commission’s 20 November update retained a year-end target. The 18 September text remains a draft. From 21 May 2027, covered non-hazardous waste for recovery may be exported to non-OECD destinations subject to the listed destination, waste entry and licensed-facility conditions. The draft entries for Indonesia and Vietnam do not include B1010 ferrous scrap. The prohibition that began on 21 November concerns plastic waste. In a separate development, the EU rejected USTR’s excess-capacity premise and called for compliance with the agreed all-inclusive 15% ceiling. USTR’s 25 November proposal would exclude EU steel and aluminium articles and relevant derivatives already subject to Section 232. Comments and hearing requests are due on 5 January 2027, and the hearing is scheduled for 25 January.
editorial.impact_zh: 涉及欧盟废钢供往印尼、越南的2027年长协时，按货物废物属性、巴塞尔代码、目的地和回收设施逐单核对，给跨越5月21日的到货约定写明最终清单变化下的交付条件及备选货源。当地电炉原料到岸成本若上升，才可能传导至其长材出口报价。美向钢材报价沿用已核定税项，按HTSUS和原产地与进口商分别核查232覆盖和301草案，勿把欧盟拟排除规则套用于中国原产货物。
editorial.impact_en: For EU-origin ferrous scrap supply contracts to Indonesia or Vietnam extending past 21 May 2027, check the waste classification, Basel code, destination and recovery facility. Tie delivery provisions to the final list and identify alternative supply. Any effect on local EAF-based long-product export offers would depend on the landed scrap cost. Keep applicable US duties in current quotes and have the importer check the HTSUS and origin separately for Section 232 and the proposed Section 301 treatment.
editorial.coverage: 核读Steelnews.biz 11月26日全文（https://steelnews.biz/new-us-tariffs-brussels-protests-but-not-at-the-rate/）、欧盟《废物运输条例》第40、41条（https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/PDF/?rid=1&uri=CELEX%3A32024R1157）、欧委会9月18日草案说明（https://environment.ec.europa.eu/news/commission-publishes-draft-list-countries-authorised-import-eu-waste-2026-09-18_en）及草案附件的公开镜像（https://www.proenvi.de/media/legal_texts/files/Anhang_Entwurf_Delegierte_Verordnung_nicht_OECD_20260918.pdf）。截至核验未取得最终清单。301范围与时限按USTR欧盟草案第V至VIII节（https://ustr.gov/sites/default/files/files/Press/Releases/2026/EU%20FRN.pdf），欧盟发言整理见https://eaccny.com/news/chapternews/european-commission-responds-to-us-tariff-threats/。

editorial.title_zh: Fastmarkets测算英欧热卷碳成本差异，英国启动欧英ETS互联实施立法
editorial.title_en: Fastmarkets models UK–EU hot-rolled coil carbon costs as UK starts ETS-link implementing legislation
editorial.summary_zh: Fastmarkets按2026年三季度价格测算，在英欧采用相同申报排放强度的假设下，高炉路线热卷在约1.5吨二氧化碳当量/吨钢处达到两地成本交点，超过该值时英国情景成本较低。该交点属于模型；英国HMRC发布的行业示例也不能作为2027年实际季度税率。欧英11月20日宣布完成ETS互联谈判，目标2028年实施。英国《欧洲伙伴关系法案》11月26日在下议院完成一读，二读安排在12月7日。英国CBAM仍按2027年1月1日启动；欧盟对英国原产货物的豁免仍需修改条例附件III。
editorial.summary_en: Fastmarkets models a crossover near 1.5 tonnes of CO₂e per tonne of blast-furnace hot-rolled coil using Q3 2026 prices and the same declared emissions intensity on both sides. The model gives the UK a lower cost above that point. The UK’s published indicative sector rates are illustrations for the methodology. On 20 November the EU and UK announced that ETS-link negotiations had concluded, with implementation targeted for 2028. The UK European Partnership Bill had its Commons first reading on 26 November and is scheduled for second reading on 7 December. The UK CBAM starts on 1 January 2027. An EU exemption for UK-origin goods requires an amendment to Annex III.
editorial.impact_zh: 中国原产热卷对英、对欧分别测算，要求钢厂提供生产路线与对应产品的实测排放，缺数据时由目的地进口商按各自商品编码和默认值复核，再约定合同碳成本分摊及季度调价。经英国转运仍按适用原产地规则审核，勿按原产地豁免重排清关。印度镀层板等竞争货源的流向变化可用于比价，仍需结合配额与反倾销等贸易措施。
editorial.impact_en: Model UK and EU landed costs separately for Chinese-origin hot-rolled coil. Request route-specific and product-specific emissions data. Where needed, have each importer check the local commodity code, default value and quarterly price before agreeing carbon-cost allocation. Account for applicable origin rules when evaluating shipments via Britain. Use shifts in competing coated flat steel offers as a market signal alongside quotas and trade remedies.
editorial.coverage: Fastmarkets原网址跳转至11月20日修订全文，保留队列11月19日匹配日期。复核模型假设、HMRC示例（https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/illustrative-cbam-rates-and-worked-example-for-carbon-border-adjustment-mechanism-cbam）、英国议会进度及法案第1条（https://bills.parliament.uk/bills/4337/news，https://publications.parliament.uk/pa/bills/cbill/59-02/0193/260193.html），以及欧委会税务与海关总司对附件III的说明（https://taxation-customs.ec.europa.eu/news/eu-and-uk-agree-link-emission-trading-systems-ets-2026-11-20_en）。

editorial.title_zh: 美国征询欧盟CBAM影响及下游扩围意见，行业评论讨论碳定价
editorial.title_en: USTR consulted on EU CBAM and downstream expansion as industry analysis examines carbon pricing
editorial.summary_zh: 美国贸易代表办公室10月8日依据案卷USTR-2026-0661，就欧盟CBAM对美国生产商、就业、直接及间接出口的影响征求意见，公告意见期截至11月9日。征询同时覆盖欧委会、理事会与欧洲议会不同的下游扩围方案。中国冶金报评论引用机构测算讨论碳价与竞争力。该案卷所核公告为征求意见程序，欧盟现行范围按条例附件I执行。
editorial.summary_en: USTR’s 8 October notice in docket USTR-2026-0661 sought public input on the effect of EU CBAM on US producers, workers and direct or indirect exports, including three different EU proposals to expand coverage. The published comment deadline was 9 November. A China Metallurgical News commentary discusses carbon pricing and competitiveness using external estimates. The notice is a request for comments. Annex I of the EU regulation governs current product coverage.
editorial.impact_zh: 对欧钢材按现行商品编码和进口商核查结果履约。涉及钢制汽车零部件及其他下游制品的长单，分别标注现行覆盖与各版提案可能覆盖的税号，预先准备钢材前体排放数据，并为最终扩围后的碳成本分摊留出合同调整条款。
editorial.impact_en: Base EU steel shipments on current product codes and importer checks. For longer contracts covering steel-intensive auto components or other downstream goods, distinguish live CBAM coverage from each proposal’s product list, prepare steel precursor emissions data and allow for potential adjustments to carbon-cost allocation.
editorial.coverage: 核读USTR正式公告的程序、日期及三版提案范围，并核读冶金工业规划研究院所转载的《中国冶金报》全文（https://www.mpi1972.cn/News_detailed/2366.html）。转载日期用于核验，保留队列日期。机构估算与评论所讨论的潜在政策均按其证据性质区分。

editorial.title_zh: 斯凯孚与中国宝武签署备忘录，拟合作开发低碳产品与下一代轴承钢
editorial.title_en: SKF and China Baowu sign memorandum on lower-carbon products and next-generation bearing steel
editorial.summary_zh: 斯凯孚11月16日公告确认与中国宝武签署谅解备忘录。拟合作领域包括低碳产品、下一代轴承钢、产品碳足迹透明度、钢铁生产设备状态监测，以及轴承再制造与回收。公开公告披露合作方向，未披露具体钢厂、产品牌号、采购量或交付时间。
editorial.summary_en: SKF announced on 16 November that it and China Baowu had signed a memorandum of understanding. Planned work includes lower-carbon products, next-generation bearing steel, product carbon footprint transparency, monitoring of steelmaking equipment, and bearing remanufacturing and recycling. The announcement gives no plant, grade, order volume or delivery timetable.
editorial.impact_zh: 欧洲轴承及工业设备客户编制低碳钢采购规格时，可向钢厂核查拟报牌号、样件计划和订单对应的排放边界及证据。按实际供货认证和产品核查材料决定能否报低碳溢价或支持进口商申报。
editorial.impact_en: For bearing and industrial equipment customers developing lower-carbon specifications, ask mills about grade, trial material and emissions evidence for the proposed supply. Base any low-carbon premium or importer declaration on qualified supply and substantiated product data.
editorial.coverage: 复核SKF 11月16日企业公告及同文企业发稿（https://news.cision.com/skf/r/skf-and-baowu-signs-mou-to-advance-innovation-and-sustainable-industrial-transformation,c4424726）。公告是签署方披露，尚无订单或产线投产文件。保留媒体队列11月17日的日期。

triage.coverage: 核到我的钢铁网页面标题及日期；另找到全国出口重点商品量值表转载（钢之家，https://www.steelhome.com/detailspage.php?nid=4791031&ntype=n）用于确认统计口径。原文章的具体数据表和海关原始分项未取得。
